agent_summary: Implemented CBTS-936 (Delete a list): deleteListAction Server Action deletes a List by id via Prisma and redirects to '/'. DeleteListButton is a new client component that skips the confirmation step for an empty list (single click deletes immediately) but shows an inline 'Delete this list and its N todo(s)?' confirm/cancel step for a non-empty list, per AC. Schema change: Todo.list relation's onDelete set to Cascade (previously unspecified/Restrict), with a hand-authored migration (20260821150000_cascade_delete_todos_on_list_delete) recreating the todos_listId_fkey constraint with ON DELETE CASCADE -- flagged for migration review per the story's implementation notes, since it wasn't run against a live database in this session.
